resources.string: Fills in the capability matrix for this phone. Type a package that is running right now, then run the checks.

\nTo test the stopped bit: open the target app\'s settings, tap Force stop, then run the checks again. If the bit flips to true, we can tell a force-stop from a memory kill.\n
